genericity_diff.left: Astra F1 acceptance names 'open dense'. This schema's frozen default is the residual/comeager form; open_dense_escape is registered below as a distinct STRICTLY STRONGER variant (a dense open set is comeager, so it implies the default) and is never silently substituted. A gate matching only the literal words 'open dense' would accept a stronger class than this one - recorded as a vocabulary risk.

the constraint manifold X^r_vac(AF) of one-ended asymptotically flat VACUUM initial data in the declared regularity class, carrying the topology induced from the weighted Sobolev product H^s_delta x H^{s-1}_{delta+1}. R1 F04 accepted: the topology is the SUBSPACE topology on the constraint set, not the topology of the unconstrained product (under the latter reading X_vac itself is meager and no G exists). X_vac is a closed subset of a Banach space, hence a Baire space, so comeagerness is non-vacuous and G is non-empty.
genericity_diff.right: the constraint manifold X^r_vac(AF) of one-ended asymptotically flat vacuum data, with the SUBSPACE topology induced from the weighted Sobolev product H^s_delta x H^{s-1}_{delta+1} (not the unconstrained product, under which X_vac would be meager and no G would exist). X_vac is a closed subset of a Banach space, hence Baire, so G is non-empty.

genericity_diff.left: True

genericity is part of the class identity. The comeager form is this class. 'For all data' is strictly stronger. The dense-open form is ALSO strictly stronger, because a dense open set is comeager (it is the countable intersection of the constant family). The comeager form does not imply the dense-open form (a comeager set can have empty interior). No strengthening may be substituted silently. See genericity.transfer_failures for the two directions.
genericity_diff.right: genericity is part of the class identity. The comeager form is this class. 'For all data' is strictly stronger. The comeager form does not imply the dense-open form (a comeager set can have empty interior). No strengthening may be substituted silently.

genericity_diff.left: the excluded set is REQUIRED to be meager; whether the named candidate families are meager is UNRESOLVED, so they are listed as obligations rather than as constructions. Candidates: data with a nonzero Killing field, data in the exactly-extendible (Cauchy-horizon) family, self-similar or scale-invariant data, finite-dimensional analytic families generated by continuation, and exactly symmetric data (see axis_registry and membership_ruling).
genericity_diff.right: meager; must contain (status unresolved) the stationary/axisymmetric Kerr data, whose maximal development DOES admit a C-infinity vacuum extension, plus self-similar and finite-dimensional analytic families

genericity_diff.left: G = intersection over n >= 1 of U_n with each U_n open and dense in X^r_vac(AF); equivalently the complement is meager (first category); G_r is non-empty because X_vac is Baire
genericity_diff.right: G = countable intersection of open dense subsets of X^r_vac(AF); complement meager; non-empty by Baire-ness

genericity_diff.left: set-level only: the class quantifies over a comeager set G of data; the schema does not decide membership of an individual datum. A single symmetric/stationary datum is expected outside G in the vacuum class, but that expectation is a proof obligation, not a schema field (flash-04 AMB-07 ruling).

subspace topology induced on X^r_vac(AF); Frechet topology for the smooth-with-decay class. Gauge invariance is handled by noting every predicate here is diffeomorphism invariant; the quotient by asymptotically-identity diffeomorphisms is NOT used to define comeagerness and remains an open technical gap (see unresolved_items).
genericity_diff.right: subspace topology on the constraint manifold; Frechet topology for the smooth-with-decay class. The diffeomorphism quotient is not used to define comeagerness (open technical gap).

genericity_diff.left: let C = intersection over n of U_n with each U_n open dense and of measure < 1/n; C is comeager and Lebesgue-null, so comeagerness does not yield full measure (a single fat-Cantor complement is open dense but not null, which is why the countable intersection is used) [R1 F03]
genericity_diff.right: let C = intersection over n of open dense U_n with measure < 1/n; C is comeager and null, so comeagerness does not yield full measure [R1 F03]

genericity_diff.left: let C be the comeager null set of the row above; then X minus C is meager and has full measure, so full measure does not yield comeagerness. (The irrationals are BOTH comeager and full-measure and therefore witness nothing - R1 F03.)
genericity_diff.right: the complement of the comeager null set above is meager with full measure; the irrationals are both and witness nothing [R1 F03]

observation_f1_not_required_by_t1: T1 is an intra-SCC rule (C0 -> C2). Its guards bind F2a/F2b only; F1 (AF-WCC-VAC-GEN) participates in no guard of T1. The G-FORM unmet phrasing 'no single frozen data class shared by F1/F2a/F2b disables the licensed C0=>C2 transfer' therefore over-states the precondition: the measured blocker is the C0/C2 pair plus unfrozen s, delta and the absent norm.
falsifiers: Pin drift: any pinned sha256 changing voids this measurement (harness exits 3).

At the pins, T1_PRECONDITION_UNMET is falsified if F2a and F2b declare byte-identical data_class subtrees AND numeric single-valued s and delta AND a declared norm slot AND identical genericity kind/topology, or if canonical F0 contains no C0->C2 allowed rule.
A frozen-field definition is falsified by a downstream artifact that fixes s, delta and the norm at a single value in a way this projection does not read.
non_claims: No mathematical statement, no gate verdict, no node status change.
Not a full-schema review of F1/F2a/F2b; it measures only the T1 guard projection.
